stops.title: The directory
stops.caption: Everybody, in one list.
stops.speech: Members is the directory. Everybody in the church is here, with their home branch and whether they have done the membership class.

stops.title: Finding somebody
stops.caption: Search by name, email or phone.
stops.speech: Type a name, an email or a phone number into the search box. You can also filter by branch, by status, or by role.

stops.title: Opening a profile
stops.caption: Their whole history, in one place.
stops.speech: Clicking a row opens that person: their contact details, their groups, their attendance and every follow-up logged about them.
